examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The compound API: build the table by hand from `<Table.Header>` / `<Table.Row>` / `<Table.HeadCell>` / `<Table.Cell>`. The result is an ordinary table — the same as the data-driven API — but you control every cell. Reach for it when a cell needs custom content; otherwise prefer `:data` + `:columns`.

examples.name: CellPresets
examples.summary: The cell presets every list shares: `Table.CellLink` for a name that opens another screen (tooltip names the destination), for a repository with its provider glyph before the name (`icon="ai ai-github"`, muted and outside the link) and for a domain with its `+N` overflow and a copy button pinned to the end edge, `Table.CellId` with a copy button, `Table.CellStatus` (one semantic chip per row), `Table.CellTags` showing as many tags as fit, `Table.CellTime` (avatar plus relative time counted from the `WebkitProvider`'s fixed `now`, the absolute time on the tooltip and for screen readers) and `Table.CellActions` (the row menu named after the row).
